profile_summary: Platform/DevOps engineer working across Azure, AWS, and GCP Kubernetes environments (AKS/EKS/GKE). Day-to-day work includes Terraform module design, Helm-based deployment lifecycle management (zero-downtime upgrades with lifecycle hooks and automated rollback), GitOps with ArgoCD, and full-stack observability using Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger, and the EFK stack. Built custom Kubernetes controllers in Go for observability data aggregation. Currently building an LLM-based SRE agent (Go + Claude/Anthropic) that aggregates Prometheus/Grafana/Jaeger/Elasticsearch/Helm state to generate RCA and execute guarded remediation actions — resolving 40–60% of incidents autonomously behind safety guardrails (approval gates, rollback policies, confidence thresholds). Also work on CVE remediation automation (Renovate, Copacetic) and zero-trust security (OPA/Gatekeeper, Istio).
resume_headline: DevOps Engineer with 4+ years of experience across Platform Engineering, Site Reliability, Multi-Cloud Infrastructure (Azure, AWS, GCP), Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, Observability, and AI Agent Integration (Claude/Anthropic)
